subject: Vendor renewal: Outreach contract extension + alternative evaluation
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Outreach renewal + quick alternatives scan

Folks —

Our Outreach contract is up for renewal in late July (renewal window opens 7/20). I pulled current usage (attached) — active seats: 62; weekly sends vary but spike with GTM campaigns. Before we auto-renew, I want to: 

- Validate whether Outreach still gives the best unit economics for our workflows
- Decide whether to (a) extend Outreach for 12 months with a seat reallocation and modest discount or (b) run a parallel 30-day PoC with Salesloft for a subset of SDRs

Asks:
- Dev — can you confirm integration risk with our HubSpot flows if we run a PoC?
- Monica — can you check with Finance whether procurement requires a formal RFP for a different vendor at this contract size?

I attached current_outreach_usage.csv for quick context. Happy to run a short evaluation matrix but want input this week so we can get quotes and legal loops started.

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive, Revenue
Redwood Inference

Attachments: current_outreach_usage.csv
From: Emma Chen <emma@outreach.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Outreach renewal + quick alternatives scan

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending usage details. I pulled a renewal quote and a short note on PoC options — see attached renewal_quote_2026.pdf. Quick summary:

- Standard renewal (62 seats) — list price $95/seat/mo; we can offer a 15% renewal discount if you commit to 12 months and keep usage within +/-10% of current seat count
- 30-day PoC for up to 10 seats on Sales Engagement Pro environment — complimentary; Outreach will provide dedicated onboarding support for the PoC and a playbook for HubSpot sync
- We can produce a DPA and SOC2 report on request (I can attach those).

If it helps, I can route a concise commercial term sheet to your procurement/legal contact for redlines. DocuSign link will be ready once terms are agreed.

Best,
Emma Chen
Account Manager — Renewals
Outreach, Inc.

Attachments: renewal_quote_2026.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Chen <emma@outreach.io>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Outreach renewal + quick alternatives scan

Looping in Neha from procurement/legal to handle redlines and security requests. Neha — Emma attached the initial quote and says Outreach can run a complimentary 30-day PoC for 10 seats.

Priority items for us:
- Data handling: retention controls, exportability, and whether outreach keeps email copies after sync
- DPA and SOC2 evidence
- Pricing flexibility: we want an early-exit pro-rata if the PoC indicates vendor mismatch

Monica — any objections to running the PoC with 10 seats (mix of 4 SDRs, 3 AEs for outbound sequencing, 3 CS for follow-ups)? Dev — please confirm if the PoC will require any changes to our HubSpot field mappings or a sandbox org.

I attached a proposed_redlines.docx with a few starter language tweaks (mostly around data retention and termination rights). Emma — please review and let us know what Outreach can accept and what needs escalation.

Thanks,
Dylan

Attachments: proposed_redlines.docx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Chen <emma@outreach.io>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor renewal: Outreach contract extension + alternative evaluation

Hi Emma / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Before we proceed to commercial sign-off we need: 

1) SOC2 Type II report (most recent) or an AICPA bridge letter;
2) Vendor Security Packet (please include data flow diagrams and retention policy);
3) Confirmation that Outreach will accept our limited-liability clause (I attached a short vendor_security_packet.pdf that lists our baseline asks).

On commercial terms: the proposed 15% discount is reasonable but we'd like a 20% band if we commit to a 12-month term and agree to an automatic seat reset review at month 6. Also request a 45-day termination clause for convenience during the PoC period.

Emma — can you confirm timelines for the SOC2 and whether Outreach can accept the termination language? Once we have SOC2 we can proceed to redline the commercial sheet and route to Finance for PO.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Procurement Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_security_packet.pdf
From: Emma Chen <emma@outreach.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor renewal: Outreach contract extension + alternative evaluation

Neha / Dylan / Dev —

Appreciate the detail. Quick updates: 

- SOC2 Type II: full report available — link sent to your security inbox + I attached a redacted summary.
- Data flow & retention: Outreach retains outbound email logs for up to 365 days by default; we can accommodate a shorter 90-day retention for selective accounts under a DPA addition.
- Termination clause: we can accept a 45-day termination for the PoC only; full contract requires 60-day notice. For the renewal discount, we can move to 18% with the 12-month commit and a 6-month seat review.

I've uploaded the updated commercial quote and DPA to the DocuSign packet here: https://app.docusign.com/packets/7a3f4b-outreach-renewal (will prompt for signature once redlines are complete). HubSpot deal: HUB-8521.

If this aligns I can prepare a final DocuSign packet for signature by next week.

Best,
Emma Chen
Account Manager — Renewals
Outreach, Inc.

Attachments: vendor_security_summary_redacted.pdf

Subject: Re: Vendor renewal: Outreach contract extension + alternative evaluation

Thanks everyone — that sounds workable. Summary / decision: 

- Proceed with a 12-month renewal with Outreach at the revised commercial terms (18% discount), seat reset review at month 6, and PoC guardrails (10-seat PoC with 45-day convenience window).
- Emma — please send the finalized DocuSign packet; Neha will sign DPA and commercial SOW once redlines are in the DocuSign packet.
- Monica / Finance — please expect a renewal invoice after DocuSign is complete; we'll request a one-time PO for the committed term.

Emma has uploaded the DocuSign packet: https://app.docusign.com/packets/7a3f4b-outreach-renewal (I also attached a signed_sof_stub.pdf as a placeholder once legal confirms redlines).

I'll mark this move-to-contract and close the evaluation track. If the PoC reveals integration issues we'll pause auto-renew and reassess.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Revenue
Redwood Inference

Attachments: signed_sof_stub.pdf
